- `fluxion-console-api-contract#RULE-fluxion-console-api-001`: Console/Control Plane 的 HTTP 响应、业务错误、请求上下文和日志必须通过统一基础设施封装，业务 Handler/Service 不得各自拼装响应或自行定义日志字段。
  - rule_sha256=eebd23eb552535a106bf7eb01ceb031fd5018d43265c0e65812edf27b648f553 verifier=fluxion-console-api-contract#RULE-fluxion-console-api-001; artifacts=hook-plugin-remediation.md,review-fixes.design.md
- `fluxion-console-channel#RULE-fluxion-console-001`: Console 与 Runtime 必须同仓共享 Contract 但可独立部署；Web Chat 是正式 Channel；未绑定身份在映射 PlatformUser 前只能执行 `/bind <code>`。
  - rule_sha256=6f467af56e6d488f22832bd3a78603819f753dde916814d7c27803265933d8e2 verifier=fluxion-console-channel#RULE-fluxion-console-001; artifacts=hook-plugin-remediation.md,review-fixes.design.md
- `fluxion-dfx#RULE-fluxion-dfx-001`: DFX 必须在编码阶段实现并通过自动化证据验证，不能在功能完成后再补。
  - rule_sha256=ff928fd8e0f23aec2eb88c5b1ee76bafc211ceaff41fa2c82a371f9f124eb0d9 verifier=fluxion-dfx#RULE-fluxion-dfx-001; artifacts=hook-plugin-remediation.md,review-fixes.design.md
- `fluxion-resource-registry#RULE-fluxion-resource-001`: 所有可配置事实必须资源化、版本化并保存于 Registry；用户/租户差异通过 Binding 表达；Registry 唯一实现为 PostgreSQL（ADR-A007 单库 Contract）。
  - rule_sha256=2b78db202932c29760263c8a59d9adb1e95b99b48ef20427346ce93b5b20eab6 verifier=fluxion-resource-registry#RULE-fluxion-resource-001; artifacts=hook-plugin-remediation.md,review-fixes.design.md
- `fluxion-workflow-capability#RULE-fluxion-workflow-001`: Tool 只是 Agent-facing Adapter；业务逻辑属于 Capability；复杂 SOP 的 Durable State 必须由 Workflow Engine 管理。
  - rule_sha256=05082bd4466fc0ad178405c479b4bf5e2bef9d662f815081fdd442fb30cc7bbb verifier=fluxion-workflow-capability#RULE-fluxion-workflow-001; artifacts=hook-plugin-remediation.md,review-fixes.design.md
